dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.agent:
Here are some highly rated, comfortable options within your budget:

- "Ulu Fairbanks Womens Grey Slipper (7 B US, grey)": $79.95, average rating 5.0 (1 review)
- "Womens Sneaker": $76.33, average rating 5.0 (2 reviews). It features advanced comfort technology, customizable fit, moisture-wicking lining, padded collar, heel counter, and sole designed to prevent heel slippage. Recommended by foot health experts.
